description: Implementation of QpackDecodedHeadersAccumulator class for handling QPACK header decoding in QUIC protocol.

classes.name: QpackDecodedHeadersAccumulator
classes.description: Handles accumulation and decoding of QPACK headers, manages header size limits, and communicates decoding results via a visitor.

methods.name: QpackDecodedHeadersAccumulator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the accumulator with stream ID, decoder, visitor, and size limit.

methods.name: OnHeaderDecoded
methods.description: Processes a decoded header name and value, updates size counters, and checks size limits.

methods.name: OnDecodingCompleted
methods.description: Finalizes header decoding, notifies visitor with the decoded headers.

methods.name: OnDecodingErrorDetected
methods.description: Handles decoding errors, notifies visitor of the error.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Feeds data into the decoder for processing.

methods.name: EndHeaderBlock
methods.description: Signals the end of the header block to the decoder.
